lessonRef.title: Launch and diagnostic: representing distributions with dot plots, histograms, and box plots

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Read the example first. You are not expected to know this yet.

items.prompt: Find the mean and median of 4, 8, 6, 10, 2.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Try each one. If you get stuck, write what you do know and move on.

items.prompt: A data set of five values between 10 and 30 has one additional reading of 235 appended. Which statement best describes the effect on the mean and the median?
choices: The mean rises sharply while the median changes little, because the mean uses every value’s size.
Both the mean and the median rise sharply.
The median rises sharply while the mean changes little.
Neither statistic changes, because one value cannot affect a summary.

items.prompt: A two-way table has row 1: 13 yes, 19 no; row 2: 30 yes, 16 no. Among row-1 respondents, what fraction answered yes?
A least-squares line for a data set is ŷ = 3x + 13, where x is measured in hour studieds and y in test points. Interpret the slope.
choices: Each additional hour studied is associated with an increase of about 3 test points.
Each additional hour studied causes an increase of exactly 3 test points.
Each additional test points is associated with 3 more hour studieds.
The predicted value is 3 test points when x is 0.

items.prompt: In a randomised trial, one group received a tutoring programme and scored higher on average than the control group. What conclusion is justified?
choices: A third variable — warm weather — plausibly drives both, so correlation here is not evidence of causation.
A strong correlation always establishes causation when the sample is large.
Random assignment makes a causal conclusion reasonable, because the groups differ only by the treatment.
Larger towns have both more engines and more fires, so the association reflects town size rather than a causal link.

items.prompt: A data set records 12, 38, 22, 25, 24, 10, 18. Give the mean and the median.
choices: mean 21.29, median 22
mean 22, median 21.29
mean 21.29, median 21
mean 21, median 22
